text:
[Council File 25-0125]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PUBLIC WORKS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to processes for repairing damaged lighting infrastructure; and streetlighting policies in other major cities with best practices that could be adopted locally.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
NOTE and FILE the Bureau of Street Lighting report dated May 15, 2026 and Chief Legislative Analyst report dated September 28, 2026, relative to processes for repairing damaged lighting infrastructure; and streetlighting policies in other major cities with best practices that could be adopted locally.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Not applicable
Community Impact Statement:
Yes statement For: Studio City Neighborhood Council
summary: Council takes up reports on how damaged streetlight infrastructure gets repaired, plus streetlighting policies from other major cities that could be adopted in Los Angeles.

details.action: review of repair processes and streetlighting policies
